mapper.select: SELECT distinct FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_NAME shortName from MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING MBCR inner join FIN_PRODUCT ON O_CODE = FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE MBCR.O_TYPE = '02' and ( FINPROD_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR MBCR.O_CODE LIKE concat(concat('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') ) UNION ALL SELECT distinct MBCR.o_code code, MCI.CUSTOMER_NAME shortName FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING MBCR LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI ON MBCR.O_CODE = MCI.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE MBCR.O_TYPE = '01' AND ( MCI.CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR MBCR.O_CODE LIKE concat(concat('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )

choose.when:
SELECT DISTINCT i.CUSTOMER_ID id, i.CUSTOMER_NAME text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO i LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD a on i.CUSTOMER_ID=a.CUSTOMER_ID
( i.CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR i.CUSTOMER_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR i.CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR a.INSITITUTE_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
( i.CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{initValue}, '%')) OR i.CUSTOMER_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{initValue}, '%')) OR i.CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{initValue}, '%')) OR a.INSITITUTE_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')) )
AND (i.IS_TRUSTER = 'Y' OR i.IS_FINANCIER = 'Y' OR i.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = 'Y' OR i.IS_GUARANTEE = 'Y' OR i.IS_PLEDGOR = 'Y' OR i.IS_DEPOSIT_BANK = 'Y')
choose.otherwise:
SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, FINPROD_ABBR text FROM FIN_PRODUCT
(FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')))
AND FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue}
AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01'
